subject.title: fix: external plugin tabs fail under gateway auth

question: Should authenticated Control UI reads mint a short-lived, route-scoped browser credential that gateway-auth plugin routes accept as delegated operator scopes?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation mechanics, but maintainers must decide whether this new browser-held credential and authorization boundary is an acceptable permanent Gateway contract.

options.title: Accept the scoped cookie handoff
options.body: Keep the current bounded design after real browser proof and required checks pass.

options.title: Use a Gateway-owned proxy
options.body: Replace browser-held grants with host-mediated authenticated proxying at the cost of additional routing complexity.

options.title: Require plugin-managed authentication
options.body: Keep gateway-auth routes unavailable to iframe tabs and document plugin-owned authentication as the supported pattern.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped cookie handoff
recommendation.body: Keep the current bounded design after real browser proof and required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin HTTP authentication model and several subsequent scope-hardening changes appear in this person's merged history.
